task_summary: Check a recent local text exchange against its prior context and report an evidence-bounded interpretation. No source content or identities in this report.

acceptance: Retrieve the most recent available records and distinguish speakers, nested statements and subsequent replies.
completed: Restored the local read-only source connection, checked the correct collection and compared it with the prior snapshot.
Read surrounding exchanges, the nested forwards and selected prior passages; refreshed the active exchange before reporting.
Saved a local readable increment and checked record uniqueness.

metrics.name: Observed interval
metrics.basis: First captured local clock to review cutoff; excludes archival.

metrics.name: Read-only reviewers
metrics.basis: One independent attribution check returned while coordinator checked context.

metrics.name: Service recovery
metrics.basis: A refused local connection was restored by starting the configured desktop application.

metrics.name: Additional records checked after first snapshot
metrics.basis: Latest saved increment extended the initial cutoff.

metrics.name: Review and archive overhead
metrics.basis: Interleaved with analysis; archive follows cutoff.

observations: Speaker attribution and message order changed which explanations were supported.
New direct statements appeared while the local source was being examined.
No matched baseline for efficiency comparison.

recommendations.action: For active exchanges, check for a recent direct answer and state the actual source cutoff. Verify attribution before reasoning about cause.
recommendations.next_check: Check the final answer against the latest saved statement and its speaker.

evidence: Local full source refresh, incremental tail, formatted text counts and independent reading.
limits: Offline events and unexpressed motives are unavailable.
Only sanitized workflow metadata is archived.
